410.subject: radio-telephony
410.title: Q-Codes — QDR and QDM
410.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "QDR = MAGNETIC BEARING FROM THE STATION", "subline": "QDM IS THE MAGNETIC BEARING TO THE STATION (QDR ± 180°)", "blocks": [{"label": "QDR", "value": "Magnetic bearing FROM the station"}, {"label": "QDM", "value": "Magnetic heading/bearing TO the station (zero wind)"}, {"label": "QTE / QUJ", "value": "True bearing from / to the station"}]}

414.subject: radio-telephony
414.title: Flight Rules vs Weather Conditions
414.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "IFR CAN BE FLOWN IN VMC OR IMC — VFR ONLY IN VMC", "subline": "VFR/IFR ARE THE RULES YOU FLY BY; VMC/IMC ARE THE WEATHER CONDITIONS", "blocks": [{"label": "VFR", "value": "Needs VMC: the pilot sees and avoids"}, {"label": "IFR", "value": "Legal in VMC and in IMC (instrument navigation, ATC separation)"}]}

428.subject: radio-telephony
428.title: Special VFR — Minimum Ceiling
428.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "SPECIAL VFR (AEROPLANE): CEILING AT LEAST 600 FT AGL", "subline": "ATC SEPARATES SVFR TRAFFIC, SO THE CEILING CAN BE LOWER THAN FOR NORMAL VFR", "blocks": [{"label": "SVFR", "value": "Ceiling ≥ 600 ft; stay clear of cloud with the surface in sight"}, {"label": "NORMAL VFR IN A CTR", "value": "Ceiling ≥ 1500 ft"}, {"label": "CLEARANCE", "value": "SVFR is only flown with an ATC clearance inside a control zone"}]}

460.subject: radio-telephony
460.title: South African Time to UTC
460.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "UTC = SOUTH AFRICAN LOCAL TIME − 2 HOURS", "subline": "SOUTH AFRICAN STANDARD TIME IS UTC+2 ALL YEAR (NO DAYLIGHT SAVING)", "blocks": [{"label": "LOCAL → UTC", "value": "Subtract 2 hours: 17:00 SAST = 15:00 UTC"}, {"label": "UTC → LOCAL", "value": "Add 2 hours: 06:30 UTC = 08:30 SAST"}]}

484.subject: radio-telephony
484.title: Filing a Flight Plan — 30 Minutes
484.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "FILE AT LEAST 30 MINUTES BEFORE DEPARTURE", "subline": "60 MINUTES FOR AN INTERNATIONAL FLIGHT", "blocks": [{"label": "WHY", "value": "The ATSU needs time to process the plan and pass it to other units"}, {"label": "EARLIEST", "value": "A flight plan may be filed up to 5 days in advance"}]}

485.subject: radio-telephony
485.title: Flight Plan Item 10 — Equipment Code S
485.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "S = V + O + L: VHF RADIO, VOR AND ILS", "subline": "THE STANDARD COM/NAV/APPROACH FIT, NO MORE AND NO LESS", "blocks": [{"label": "V", "value": "VHF radiotelephony"}, {"label": "O", "value": "VOR"}, {"label": "L", "value": "ILS"}, {"label": "ANYTHING ELSE", "value": "Add its own letter, e.g. D for DME, F for ADF"}]}

506.subject: radio-telephony
506.title: Backtrack the Runway
506.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "BACKTRACK = TAXI ON THE RUNWAY AGAINST THE DIRECTION IN USE", "subline": "USED WHEN THERE IS NO PARALLEL TAXIWAY TO REACH THE THRESHOLD", "blocks": [{"label": "WHERE", "value": "On the active runway — follow the clearance exactly"}, {"label": "THEN", "value": "Turn around at the end and line up, or vacate, as cleared"}]}

518.subject: radio-telephony
518.title: Line Up and Wait
518.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "LINE UP AND WAIT: ENTER THE RUNWAY, LINE UP, DO NOT TAKE OFF", "subline": "IT IS NOT A TAKE-OFF CLEARANCE", "blocks": [{"label": "DO", "value": "Taxi onto the runway and line up on the centreline"}, {"label": "DON'T", "value": "Start the take-off roll until cleared for take-off"}, {"label": "READ BACK", "value": "'Lining up and waiting, runway 03'"}]}

567.subject: radio-telephony
567.title: The Three Emergency (SAR) Phases
567.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "UNCERTAINTY → ALERT → DISTRESS", "subline": "INCERFA → ALERFA → DETRESFA: THE RESPONSE GROWS AS CONCERN GROWS", "blocks": [{"label": "INCERFA", "value": "Uncertainty: doubt about the aircraft's safety"}, {"label": "ALERFA", "value": "Alert: apprehension about the aircraft and occupants"}, {"label": "DETRESFA", "value": "Distress: reasonable certainty of grave and imminent danger"}]}

570.subject: radio-telephony
570.title: Ground-to-Air Signal — V
570.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "V = REQUIRE ASSISTANCE", "subline": "LAY OUT LARGE, HIGH-CONTRAST STRIPS SO A SEARCH AIRCRAFT CAN READ THEM", "blocks": [{"label": "V", "value": "Require assistance"}, {"label": "X", "value": "Require medical assistance"}, {"label": "N / Y", "value": "No (negative) / Yes (affirmative)"}]}

764.subject: air-law
764.title: Accident Notification — Time Limit
764.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "NOTIFY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE — AND NEVER LATER THAN 24 HOURS", "subline": "A GENERAL DUTY WITH A HARD BACKSTOP", "blocks": [{"label": "AS SOON AS POSSIBLE", "value": "Injured people, SAR and evidence are all time-critical"}, {"label": "LATEST", "value": "24 hours after the accident"}, {"label": "WHO", "value": "The PIC (or the operator if the PIC cannot)"}]}

893.subject: air-law
893.title: PPL Theory — Two Separate Clocks
893.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "SKILLS TEST WITHIN 36 MONTHS OF THE FINAL THEORY PASS", "subline": "AND ALL THEORY EXAMS WITHIN 18 MONTHS OF THE FIRST CREDIT", "blocks": [{"label": "CLOCK 1", "value": "18 months to pass the whole exam series"}, {"label": "CLOCK 2", "value": "36 months from the final pass to the skills test"}]}

898.subject: air-law
898.title: PPL(A) — Minimum Flight Time
898.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "AT LEAST 25 OF THE 45 HOURS MUST BE DUAL INSTRUCTION", "subline": "45 HOURS IS THE MINIMUM TOTAL FLIGHT TIME FOR THE PPL(A)", "blocks": [{"label": "DUAL", "value": "At least 25 h with a flight instructor"}, {"label": "THE REST", "value": "Includes the required solo and solo cross-country flying"}, {"label": "TOTAL", "value": "At least 45 h"}]}

910.subject: air-law
910.title: PPL(A) Long Navigation Flight
910.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "150 NM, ONE POINT ≥ 50 NM FROM BASE, TWO FULL-STOP LANDINGS AWAY", "subline": "THE TWO LANDINGS ARE AT DIFFERENT AERODROMES, NOT AT BASE", "blocks": [{"label": "DISTANCE", "value": "At least 150 NM in total"}, {"label": "REACH", "value": "At least one point 50 NM or more from base"}, {"label": "LANDINGS", "value": "Two full-stop landings at two different aerodromes away from base"}]}

1019.subject: air-law
1019.title: Definition of Night
1019.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "NIGHT = 15 MIN AFTER SUNSET TO 15 MIN BEFORE SUNRISE", "subline": "THE MIRROR IMAGE OF THE DEFINITION OF DAY", "blocks": [{"label": "STARTS", "value": "Sunset + 15 minutes"}, {"label": "ENDS", "value": "Sunrise − 15 minutes"}, {"label": "WHY IT MATTERS", "value": "Flying in this window needs a night rating"}]}

1028.subject: air-law
1028.title: Head-On Approach — Both Turn Right
1028.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "HEAD-ON: BOTH AIRCRAFT ALTER HEADING TO THE RIGHT", "subline": "THEY PASS LEFT SIDE TO LEFT SIDE", "blocks": [{"label": "WHY RIGHT", "value": "One predictable response, so pilots never turn into each other"}, {"label": "CONVERGING", "value": "The aircraft with the other on its right gives way"}, {"label": "OVERTAKING", "value": "Overtake by altering heading to the right"}]}

1034.subject: air-law
1034.title: Documents Carried on a Domestic Flight
1034.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "RELEASE TO SERVICE, CERTIFICATE OF REGISTRATION, PILOT'S LICENCE", "subline": "ORIGINALS OR CERTIFIED COPIES — DOMESTIC FLIGHTS INCLUDED", "blocks": [{"label": "RELEASE TO SERVICE", "value": "Proves the aircraft is airworthy after maintenance"}, {"label": "REGISTRATION", "value": "Proves who the aircraft is"}, {"label": "LICENCE", "value": "Proves the pilot is qualified"}]}

1049.subject: air-law
1049.title: VFR Minima — Low Level, Uncontrolled Airspace
1049.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "5 KM VISIBILITY, CLEAR OF CLOUD, SURFACE IN SIGHT", "subline": "CLASS F/G AT OR BELOW 3000 FT AMSL OR 1000 FT ABOVE TERRAIN, BY DAY", "blocks": [{"label": "VISIBILITY", "value": "5 km flight visibility (aeroplanes)"}, {"label": "CLOUD", "value": "Clear of cloud"}, {"label": "SURFACE", "value": "Ground or water in sight"}]}

1061.subject: air-law
1061.title: Filing a Flight Plan — Lead Time
1061.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "FILE AT LEAST 30 MINUTES BEFORE DEPARTURE", "subline": "FOR A DEPARTURE INTO CONTROLLED OR ADVISORY AIRSPACE, UNLESS THE ATSU AGREES OTHERWISE", "blocks": [{"label": "DOMESTIC", "value": "At least 30 min before departure"}, {"label": "INTERNATIONAL", "value": "At least 60 min before departure"}]}

1062.subject: air-law
1062.title: VFR Minima — 3000 ft AMSL / 1000 ft AGL to 10 000 ft
1062.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "5 KM VISIBILITY, 1.5 KM HORIZONTALLY AND 1000 FT VERTICALLY FROM CLOUD", "subline": "ABOVE 3000 FT AMSL OR 1000 FT ABOVE TERRAIN (HIGHER OF THE TWO), BELOW 10 000 FT AMSL", "blocks": [{"label": "VISIBILITY", "value": "5 km flight visibility"}, {"label": "HORIZONTAL", "value": "1.5 km from cloud"}, {"label": "VERTICAL", "value": "1000 ft from cloud"}]}

1080.subject: air-law
1080.title: Semi-Circular Rule
1080.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "THE SEMI-CIRCULAR RULE APPLIES AT AND ABOVE 1500 FT AGL", "subline": "CRUISING LEVEL CHOSEN BY MAGNETIC TRACK, UNLESS ATC DIRECTS OTHERWISE", "blocks": [{"label": "000° – 179°", "value": "Odd thousands; VFR adds 500 ft (3500, 5500, 7500 …)"}, {"label": "180° – 359°", "value": "Even thousands; VFR adds 500 ft (4500, 6500, 8500 …)"}, {"label": "BELOW 1500 FT AGL", "value": "The rule does not apply"}]}

1086.subject: air-law
1086.title: Scuba Diving and Flying
1086.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "NO FLIGHT CREW DUTIES WITHIN 24 HOURS OF SCUBA DIVING", "subline": "DISSOLVED NITROGEN CAN FORM BUBBLES AT LOWER CABIN PRESSURE", "blocks": [{"label": "RISK", "value": "Decompression sickness ('the bends') at altitude"}, {"label": "RULE", "value": "Wait at least 24 hours after diving before acting as crew"}]}

1093.subject: air-law
1093.title: Minimum Height Over Built-Up Areas
1093.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "1000 FT ABOVE THE HIGHEST OBSTACLE WITHIN 2000 FT OF THE AIRCRAFT", "subline": "EXCEPT FOR TAKE-OFF, LANDING OR WITH WRITTEN APPROVAL", "blocks": [{"label": "VERTICAL", "value": "At least 1000 ft above the highest obstacle"}, {"label": "RADIUS", "value": "Obstacles within 2000 ft of the aircraft count"}, {"label": "WHY", "value": "Room to glide clear of the town if the engine fails"}]}

1383.subject: air-law
1383.title: What Empty Mass Includes
1383.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "EMPTY MASS = AIRFRAME + FIXED EQUIPMENT + UNUSABLE FUEL + ALL OIL, COOLANT, HYDRAULIC FLUID", "subline": "EVERYTHING THAT STAYS IN THE AIRCRAFT; PAYLOAD AND USABLE FUEL ARE ADDED PER FLIGHT", "blocks": [{"label": "INCLUDED", "value": "Coolant, unusable fuel, total oil, total hydraulic fluid, fixed ballast, fixed equipment"}, {"label": "NOT INCLUDED", "value": "Usable fuel, crew, passengers, baggage"}]}

1400.subject: air-law
1400.title: Flight Time (Aeroplane)
1400.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "FLIGHT TIME RUNS FROM FIRST MOVEMENT FOR TAKE-OFF TO COMING TO REST", "subline": "IT INCLUDES TAXI TIME — IT IS NOT JUST THE AIRBORNE TIME", "blocks": [{"label": "STARTS", "value": "When the aeroplane first moves under its own power for take-off"}, {"label": "ENDS", "value": "When it finally comes to rest at the end of the flight"}, {"label": "NOT", "value": "Engine start to shutdown, or lift-off to touchdown"}]}

1401.subject: air-law
1401.title: Passenger Age Categories
1401.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "CHILD = FROM THE 2ND BIRTHDAY UP TO 12 YEARS", "subline": "UNDER 2 IS AN INFANT; FROM 12 THE PASSENGER IS TREATED AS AN ADULT", "blocks": [{"label": "INFANT", "value": "Under 2 years"}, {"label": "CHILD", "value": "2 to 12 years"}, {"label": "ADULT", "value": "12 years and older"}]}

1402.subject: air-law
1402.title: Accident Notification — Order of Priority
1402.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "DIRECTOR → ATSU → NEAREST POLICE STATION", "subline": "THE AUTHORITY THAT DIRECTS THE INVESTIGATION IS TOLD FIRST", "blocks": [{"label": "1 DIRECTOR", "value": "Director of Civil Aviation (SACAA): starts the investigation"}, {"label": "2 ATSU", "value": "Air traffic services: manages the airspace and alerts SAR"}, {"label": "3 POLICE", "value": "Nearest police station: secures and guards the site"}]}

1407.subject: air-law
1407.title: Over-Water Flight — Life Rafts
1407.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "BEYOND 30 MIN AT CRUISE OR 50 NM FROM LAND — WHICHEVER IS LESS — CARRY LIFE RAFTS", "subline": "A FORCED LANDING THAT FAR OUT MEANS DITCHING AND WAITING FOR RESCUE", "blocks": [{"label": "TRIGGER", "value": "30 minutes at normal cruising speed or 50 NM, whichever is less"}, {"label": "EQUIPMENT", "value": "Life rafts and survival equipment for everyone on board"}]}

1429.subject: air-law
1429.title: Logbook Entries — Away From Base
1429.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "AWAY FROM BASE: UPDATE THE LOGBOOK WITHIN 48 HOURS OF RETURNING", "subline": "ROUTINE ENTRIES OTHERWISE HAVE A 7-DAY WINDOW", "blocks": [{"label": "AWAY FROM BASE", "value": "Within 48 h after returning to base"}, {"label": "ROUTINE", "value": "Within 7 days"}]}

2814.subject: radio-telephony
2814.title: Contaminated Runway
2814.template: {"kicker": "KEY FACT", "headline": "CONTAMINATED: MORE THAN 25% OF THE RUNWAY COVERED", "subline": "BY STANDING WATER DEEPER THAN 3 MM, SLUSH, SNOW OR ICE", "blocks": [{"label": "AREA", "value": "More than 25% of the required runway length and width"}, {"label": "WHAT COUNTS", "value": "Standing water deeper than 3 mm, or slush, snow or ice"}, {"label": "WHY IT MATTERS", "value": "Braking and aquaplaning change enough to need separate performance data"}]}
